keyPoints: Ghan (cube) ka kul prishthiya kshetrafal = 6a² aur aaytan = a³, jahan a kinare ki lambai hai — paasa iska sabse aam udaharan hai.
Ghanabh (cuboid) ka kul prishthiya = 2(lb + bh + hl); aaytan = l x b x h — kamra, dibba isi aakaar ke hote hain.
Belan (cylinder) ka vakr prishthiya = 2πrh, kul prishthiya = 2πr(r + h), aaytan = πr²h — pipe, drum, tel ka dibba.
Kamre ki chaaron deevaron ka kshetrafal = 2h(l + b) — farsh aur chhat isme nahi judte, sirf chaar deevaren.
Aaytan ki ikai ghan ikai hoti hai — 1 m = 100 cm, isliye 1 m³ = 10,00,000 cm³; ikai badalna mat bhoolo.
Khokhli belnakar pipe ka aaytan = bahari aaytan - andaruni aaytan — lohe ka bhaag hi gina jaata hai.
Aam galti: belan ke kul prishthiya me dono vrittakar sire bhool jana — 2πrh sirf vakr bhaag hai, kul me 2πr² aur jodo.
subject: Maths
title: 3D Aakaron ka Kshetrafal aur Aaytan
